gloss: heart and soul; one's utmost energy

definitions.gloss: heart and soul; one's utmost energy
definitions.explanation: The whole of a person's mental and physical energy, thought of as something poured into a long undertaking. Used almost exclusively in the set phrase {心血|しんけつ}を{注|そそ}ぐ.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{心血|しんけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}いだ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧。
examples.english: He poured his heart and soul into his research.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{心血|しんけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}いで→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}させた→完成させる：02519_kanseisaseru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: This work is one my father completed by pouring his whole self into it.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって{心血|しんけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}いで→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧きた⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧{不足|ぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧になった。
examples.english: The project she had devoted herself to for ten years was cancelled for lack of funds.

notes:
{心|しん} (heart, mind) + {血|けつ} (blood): the image is of giving both spirit and lifeblood.

USAGE:
Almost never used alone. The phrase {心血|しんけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧ takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ for the object of the effort (⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{心血|しんけつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧), and fits work carried on over years rather than a single burst of effort. Written and somewhat elevated in tone.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}を{尽|つ}くす→全力を尽くす：15728_zenryokuwotsukusu⟧: to do one's very best — neutral, and usable of a short effort
- ⟦{精魂|せいこん}→精魂：17747_seikon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}める→込める：01945_komeru⟧: to put one's soul into — similar in weight, focused on craftsmanship
- {丹精|たんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}める→込める：01945_komeru⟧: to work with painstaking care — typically of gardening or handiwork
